skills.name: Megiddo
skills.description: Attacks with countless light beams. Bad effects on allies.  *Continuously cancels enemy invincibility (5 sec) *ATK x 3000% Area Damage  *Enemy Skill Evade Rate -40% (5 sec)

skills.name: Raphael
skills.description: Transforms into Raphael. Good effects on allies.  *Skill Use Rate +50%  (7 sec) *Skill Hit Rate +40% (7 sec) *ATK +300% (7 sec)

abilities.name: Group: TenSura2
abilities.description: TenSura2 Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Enemy Cost Increase2
abilities.description: Gives a set chance of greatly increasing the Mineral Cost for one of the opposing team's Rangers when Rangers with this Ability are deployed.  This Ability can activate from 10 seconds after the battle starts.
